why_trail.why: Implementer rewrote RedBeforeGreenAfterTests.test_bare_verb_workaround_was_accepted_before_this_change to neutralize _reject_instruction_shaped (monkeypatch to no-op, restore in finally) on load_current() instead of git-showing a historical revision. Deleted PRE_CHANGE_REV/_git_show/load_pre_change and the now-unused subprocess import. Independently verified: pytest -q on the file gives 9 passed; grep for 2c46cab8/subprocess/git show/_git_show/load_pre_change/PRE_CHANGE_REV returns nothing; git status shows only this one test file touched in the source tree. Attribution proof intact: same test still proves the guard call causes the rejection, now via neutralize/restore on the same live module rather than a historical git revision.

Independent reviewer reproduced all four checks: git status scoped to the one file, no git/subprocess/2c46cab8/pytest.skip in the file, traced _reject_instruction_shaped to its 3 real call sites confirming the monkeypatch genuinely intercepts them (not a vacuous no-op the pair would pass under regardless), pytest -v gives 9 passed 0 skipped 0 failed, and none of the excluded files were touched. Verdict APPROVE, no blockers.
Full clean-env cache-clean suite: 3040 passed, 6 skipped, 1146 subtests, 0 failed -- matches the pre-change baseline exactly. Reviewer verdict APPROVE integrated via e-g1-review-2.
